capabilities: Insert TARGET DECK into note body or YAML with filename-based templates
Insert or remove [[Note#Heading]] backlinks under question and cloze headings
Clean specified characters from card headings and tidy list spacing
Convert symmetric markers like == to Anki {{cN::…}} cloze syntax and back
Batch process in-scope files on demand or on a 15/30/60-minute timer
disambiguation: Does not sync or export cards to Anki itself; it only prepares notes for the obsidian_to_anki plugin.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian >= 1.5.0; installation is manual (place in .obsidian/plugins and build with npm). Settings UI is bilingual (Chinese/English).
intentEvidence: An enhancement plugin that pairs with obsidian_to_anki for workflows where headings act as questions
problem: Using headings as Anki questions with obsidian_to_anki requires manually inserting deck fields, backlinks, and cloze syntax and cleaning up headings and lists by hand.

relations.evidence: An enhancement plugin that pairs with obsidian_to_anki for workflows where headings act as questions

summary: Note-preparation helper for the obsidian_to_anki workflow that inserts target decks, heading backlinks, list cleanup, and cloze marker conversion.
